correctness.rationale: For N=2p^alpha even and x=p/a of valuation one, differentiating sum_{k<=N}(X^k+(-X/(1-X))^k)/k gives X^N((1-X)^(-N-1)-(1-X)^(-1)). Coefficient integration yields [(binom(N+j,j)-1)/(N+j+1)]X^(N+j+1), j>=1. j=1 has valuation N+alpha+2 for odd p. The telescoping identity binom(N+j,j)-1=N sum_{h=1}^j binom(N+h-1,h-1)/h bounds each remaining term at N+alpha+3 or higher, including the p=3 and p=5 boundary j=3,4. A single strictly lowest p-adic term cannot cancel. Independent direct exact rational evaluation in 30 cases (p=3,5,7, alpha=1,2, signed p-units) matched. No claim for p=2 or unrestricted indices.
